title: Empowering Polymeric Materials Discovery by Artificial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2606.20753v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Polymeric materials underpin modern technologies spanning energy storage, microelectronics, healthcare and sustainable manufacturing. Yet their rational design remains exceptionally challenging because material performance emerges from complex interactions among molecular composition, chain architecture, processing history and hierarchical structural evolution across multiple length and time scales. Consequently, polymer research has long relied on labor-intensive experimentation and fragmented modeling approaches, limiting both mechanistic understanding and innovation efficiency. Recent advances in data infrastructure, machine learning, large artificial intelligence (AI) models and laboratory automation are beginning to reshape this landscape. Rather than functioning as isolated tools, polymer databases, predictive models, AI agents and automated laboratories are increasingly converging into interconnected discovery ecosystems

translated_title: 赋能聚合物材料发现的人工智能
translated_abstract: 聚合物材料支撑着现代技术，涵盖能源存储、微电子、医疗保健和可持续制造等领域。然而，其理性设计仍极具挑战性，因为材料性能源于分子组成、链结构、加工历史以及跨多个长度和时间尺度的层次结构演化之间的复杂相互作用。因此，聚合物研究长期以来依赖劳动密集型实验和碎片化的建模方法，限制了机理理解和创新效率。数据基础设施、机器学习、大型人工智能（AI）模型和实验室自动化方面的最新进展正开始重塑这一格局。聚合物数据库、预测模型、AI代理和自动化实验室不再是孤立工具，而是日益融合成互联的发现生态系统。
tldr: 本文综述了人工智能如何通过整合数据、模型、代理和自动化实验室，推动聚合物材料发现向互联生态系统转型。
en_tdlr: This paper reviews how artificial intelligence is transforming polymeric materials discovery into interconnected ecosystems by integrating data, models, agents, and automated laboratories.
